skill.name: typst-pdf-maker
skill.description: Generate professional, high-quality PDF documents with Typst. Use for reports, academic papers, resumes, structured documents, mathematical typesetting, code-rich documents, precise layouts, and CJK typography when Markdown-to-PDF is insufficient. Select one skill-owned asset or compatible Typst Universe base before adding packages. Route ordinary presentation requests to Manus Slides/PPTX unless the user explicitly requires Typst-generated PDF slides.
skill.userDescription: Generate professional, high-quality PDF documents using Typst with precise typography, math formulas, and code highlighting.
exampleQuestions: Create a professional academic research paper in PDF format using Typst, complete with abstract, bibliography, and math equations.
Generate a clean, well-formatted technical report with code highlighting and structured tables.
Design a modern two-column professional resume in PDF format with custom typography.
